text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: With this, I have acquired yet another brilliant radiance.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a splendid victory!
Yeah, that was a magnificent win!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. This race, too,
was quite a grueling trial...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To claim victory against such formidable warriors.
It is extremely simple, yet there is no trial more severe,
nor more terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because of that, I feel the brilliance
I've attained here holds true value.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming a great ordeal strengthens the heart
and solidifies one's existence as a Saint, after all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even if even greater hardships
befall me from here on... I'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because today's saintess is even more special
than yesterday's—and tomorrow's saintess
will be even more special than today's!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's keep gathering radiance just like this!

text_block_list.text:

than yesterday's—and tomorrow's saintess

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! As long as I am with you, Trainer,
I feel as though I could overcome
any trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Surely, the day we reach that 'distant land'
is not far off.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am fully aware that this road will only become harsher and filled with hardships.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, with each step forward, I become all the more special as a Saint—and my march will not cease.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Until the moment we reach the gates of the alternate world,
there is nowhere to go but forward!
